personality_one_liner: A highly readable, structured, and professional operational tool that frames property content and dense financial data with quiet authority.

spacing.rule: Use generous vertical breathing room for dashboards. Cards never flush to screen edge; use md or lg margin. Forms use single column.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of active properties, today's arrivals/departures, and quick actions for invoices and reports.

states.empty: Illustration of a house with 'No active properties assigned.'
states.error: Error loading dashboard data + Retry button

screens.layout: Role-based view. For Admins: Use a multi-column grid (2-col) for high-level metrics (Total Revenue, Active Bookings) styled with Mono font. Below, a single column list of 'Today's Actionable Items' (cleanings to verify, check-ins). Stick a primary CTA FAB 'Generate Invoice' using glassmorphism at the bottom.

screens.name: Properties
screens.purpose: Manage all villas, owner details, revenue split ratios, and electricity rules.

states.empty: Icon of a building + 'No properties added yet.' + 'Add Property' CTA
states.error: Failed to load properties + Retry button

screens.layout: Single column list. Each property card uses an edge-to-edge width minus padding. Include a cover image (with gradient scrim) for each villa. Display key stats (Rev Share %, Owner Name) directly below the image. Tap to view property details and interactive reports.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Multi-month view to check availability, OTA sync status, and cleaning state of each villa.

states.error: Failed to sync iCal data + Retry button

screens.layout: Multi-month scrollable calendar picker at the top. Highlight dates with pill indicators (or dots) for booking status. Below the calendar, display a TimeSlot/Booking List for the selected date, showing OTA source (iCal) and cleaning status (Pending/Done) with status-colored tags.

screens.name: CleaningTasks
screens.purpose: Linear workflow for cleaning staff to document before and after states per room.

states.empty: Checkmark icon + 'All cleanings completed for today!'
states.error: Could not load task details + Retry button

screens.layout: Smart Task List grouped by property. When a task is tapped, show a Room-by-Room digital checklist. For each room, provide a side-by-side or split-screen 'Before' and 'After' photo capture area. Use full-bleed camera views for capture. 'Submit Report' button pinned to the bottom of the scroll view.

screens.name: ClientReport
screens.purpose: Detailed view for owners showing revenue splits, generated invoices, and latest property photos interactively.

states.empty: Chart icon + 'No data available for this period'
states.error: Failed to fetch report + Retry button

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top to toggle timeframes. Use large Space Grotesk typography for financial splits (Revenue, Electricity deductions). Display an interactive chart section. Include a Masonry or 2-col grid for latest property status photos (Before/Afters). Sticky share button at the bottom for PDF export.

instructions_to_main_agent: The user explicitly requested Navy Blue (#1B3A6B-ish) as the primary brand color based on the Britsmaid logo, which overrides the standard ban on navy blue.
Use 'Space Grotesk' or a similar Mono font for rendering financial numbers, revenue shares, and calendar dates to improve readability, paired with 'Geist' for standard UI text.
Implement role-based routing (Admin vs Cleaning Staff) via JWT login state. The dashboard and navigation should adapt based on the user's role.
The app must ONLY have a Light theme as requested. Do not implement dark mode.
For the cleaning workflow, ensure the camera/photo capture UI uses a split-screen or side-by-side 'Before & After' preview for immediate comparison before submission.
When overlaying text on property cover images, ALWAYS use a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
For interactive owner reports, use clear segmented controls for timeframes and large mono-typography for revenue metrics. Enable PDF generation using standard Expo print/share APIs.
